summary: SBA Communications Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a public offering of three tranches of senior unsecured notes due 2030, 2031, and 2033. The filing does not disclose specific interest rates, principal amounts, or pricing. Proceeds will be used to repay the 2024 Term Loan and outstanding borrowings under the Revolving Credit Facility, and concurrently enter into a new $2.5 billion unsecured revolving credit facility. The notes are not listed on any exchange. This is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation event.
